notes.title: Trading Cards, Console Ports and Sale!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Over the past few weeks, I’ve released a bunch of smaller updates that mostly addressed bugs reported in the forums or on Discord. Today, I'm happy to share with you a bigger Steam-related update!

[h2]Community Items[/h2]
Starting right now, Dead of Darkness also has community items!
[list] [*] [b]Trading Cards[/b] – These showcase some of the detailed creature concept art created for the game, along with additional information on each creature.
[*] [b]Badges[/b]
[*] [b]Emoticons[/b] – Showing various expressions of Miles and Olivia, some of which weren’t even used in the final release.
[*] [b]Backgrounds[/b] – Based on the game’s key art, some also show additional creature details.
[/list]
[h2]Console Ports[/h2]
This is the question I get the most, and while I don’t think it affects the majority of you here, a few words on console ports:
The game will release on PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series, and Nintendo Switch.
The ports are being developed by eastasiasoft, so I'm not actively involved at this stage.
They are slated for a 2025 release, but no definite date has been announced yet.

[h2]SALE![/h2]
I'm also happy to announce that the first ever custom sale of Dead of Darkness has launched!
[b]You can get the game for 20% off until April 22nd![/b]

[h2]Big Thank You and a Few Words About the Future[/h2]
Lastly, I’d like to thank everyone who has played and/or supported the game up to this point!
I’ve been overwhelmed by the amount of positive feedback — here in the forums and review section, as well as on YouTube, Twitch, and other social media platforms.
I'm always happy to read new reviews (I think I’ve read all of them up to this point!), so if you haven’t dropped one yet, please consider doing so if time allows. :)

It's worth noting that there will be no DLC or additional game content for Dead of Darkness.
This part of the story as it stands now is how I envisioned it, and I don’t want to bloat or extend it unnecessarily.
It was also important to me to deliver a game that comes complete from the start, with everything unlockable just by playing it (Very Hard difficulty, In the Dead of Darkness difficulty, New Game Plus).

That said, while I’ll continue to support the game with bug fixes and smaller adjustments, I’ll soon be moving on to my next project (potentially related to this one — who knows, right? :) ).


Markus

Should you have run into this issue, please reach out to me either on Discord or contact[ at ]retrofictiongames[ dot ]com, so that we can see if I can help you fix your save game. 
More details below:

[*] Fixed a bug where the game could crash in the bar in Graham Manor when accidentally clicking with the mouse on a invisible debugging trigger area in the outer frame of the room
[*] Fixed a bug where skipping the [spoiler]St. Albion sequence AFTER Olivia gave Miles the injection[/spoiler] could cause Olivias data to be erased (inventory, itemchest etc.)
[*] Fixed a bug where blood pools were visible on the floor during the cutscenes in the wellspring in which the spike traps were deactivated, in case the player was suffering from the bleed status
[*] Fixed a bug where painkillers didn't spawn on the desk in Graham Memorial when skipping the dialogue with the nurse
[*] Fixed a bug where ghouls didn't reach the player in a room in Graham Manor 2F
[/list]

notes.title: Dead of Darkness is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Dead of Darkness is OUT NOW on Steam!

Experience an old-school survival-horror adventure with a gripping story. Will you survive the horrors that lurk on Velvet Island?

Save often.
Plan your routes and inventory space carefully.
Only fight when you have to.
Adjust the difficulty if you have to. Depending on your choices, the game can be challenging even on Moderate.

As the Steam page says, I HIGHLY recommend playing the game with a controller. If you have to stick to the keyboard, you can rebind most buttons to your personal preference.


With all that said: Now go get yourself a bag of Cheetos and a bottle of Surge, hook up your PC to the next CRT you can find, put your phone off the hook, shut the curtains, fire up Dead of Darkness and game like it's 1996.


I hope you will enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game Details
notes.notes:
Hi all,

with the release date coming closer, I'd like to share with you some details on what you can expect from [i]Dead of Darkness[/i].

[h3][b]Game Length[/b][/h3]
The total game length of [i]Dead of Darkness[/i] will be somewhere around [b]12 hours[/b], depending on the difficulty setting (see below) and your playstyle. It's grown much bigger than I originally anticipated!

[h3][b]Difficulty Settings[/b][/h3]
There will be six difficulty settings in [i]Dead of Darkness[/i], four available from the start and two unlockable:

[list]
[*] [b]Very Easy[/b] – Essentially a story mode, ideal for those unfamiliar with survival horror games or who simply want to enjoy the story.
[*] [b]Easy[/b] – Easier than Normal, while still providing tense moments without major challenges. You won't have to worry about resource management on this difficulty setting.
[*] [b]Moderate[/b] – If you're a survival horror veteran and know when do dodge enemies/how to manage your resources, this will most likely not be a challenge for you. If you're unfamiliar with classic survival-horror games though, this will already offer a descent challenge.
[*] [b]Hard[/b] – Expect faster, stronger, more resilient enemies, and generally more of them in this mode. Planning your routes, kills and resources is essential to survive in this mode.
[*] [b]Very Hard[/b] – Everything Hard mode has, but even more intense! There are a few more mean surprises in terms of obstacles and enemy placements. You need to pay very close attention to your resources and save as much of them as you can. You need to beat the game once to unlock this.
[*] [b]In the Dead of Darkness[/b] – Enemies hit like trucks, are very fast, and take significant punishment before going down. There are even more enemies, and some traps are deadlier. You’ll need to be very familiar with the game to survive this mode, and even then [u]you will die[/u]. I recommend playing this in New Game Plus the first time around (more on that below). Unlock this by beating the game on Very Hard.
[/list]
You can change the difficulty whenever you like in the game, so don’t stress too much about your initial choice!

[h3][b]New Game Plus[/b][/h3]
Happy to announce that New Game Plus will be available [b]at launch[/b]. 
You can carry your maxed-out weapons into your new game and choose whatever difficulty setting you prefer.

[h3][b]Achievements[/b][/h3]
There will be [b]50 achievements[/b], some of which will be pretty hard to unlock. I’m curious to see who will be the first one to do it (if anyone makes it at all!) – let me know!

[h3][b]Zapping System Inspirations[/b][/h3]
During the story, you will alternate between playing as Miles and Olivia. What you do with one character can influence your playthrough with the other one. That means you can leave ammo in a certain room, so the other character can pick it up later. The same goes for unlocking shortcuts, taking out enemies, or uncovering parts of the map.

This will be especially helpful in higher difficulty settings when you need to plan your routes and use of resources very carefully.


I hope this gives you a better picture of what you can expect when the game releases on [b]January 23rd[/b]!

Let me know if you have any questions!

Markus

notes.title: Release Date announcement
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I'm happy to finally share that [i]Dead of Darkness[/i] will release on Steam on [b]January 23rd, 2025[/b]!

It's been almost 4 years since I drafted the first few ideas for the game late at night on Christmas Eve 2020. Back then, I never would have thought that the project would grow to the size and scope it has today—let alone reach an actual Steam release!

In case you missed it, here is the list of the voice cast for [i]Dead of Darkness[/i]:

Bradley Gareth ([i]"My Time at Portia", "Genshin Impact","Tiny Tina's Wonderlands"[/i])
Abigail Turner ([i]"Remothered: Broken Porcelain","My Time at Portia","Immortals of Aveum"[/i])
Paul Moran ([i]"Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader"[/i])
Alex Mai ([i]"Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty","Live A Live","One Piece"[/i])
Alice Himora ([i]"Re: Cutie Honey", "Honkai: Star Rail.","Ikai"[/i])
Ginger Sue ([i]"My Time at Sandrock","Devil May Cry: Peak of Combat","Genshin Impact"[/i])
Christ Sharpes ([i]"Return of the Obra Dinn","Grim Dawn: Forgotten Gods","Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader"[/i])
Katie Aitken ([i]"Ophelia's Chapter", "President Rocket"[/i])
Jericho George
Pixie Willow

Here is the release date trailer, with some new gameplay scenes:

[previewyoutube=mgkquIEORjM;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you guys for your support! 
I wish you all a wonderful holiday season and hope to see you when [i]Dead of Darkness[/i] launches on [b]January 23rd[/b]!


Markus

notes.title: Dead of Darkness Demo NOW available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

As we find ourselves amidst the spooky season, I am absolutely thrilled to introduce the very first DEMO of Dead of Darkness! The demo is now available for download, and it's time to dive right in!

My focus for this demo lies firmly on the gameplay aspect. It's designed to give you a hands-on taste of the gaming experience, with just a dash of story to set the stage for what's to come in the full release.

Keep in mind that this demo covers approximately 5-10% of the final game and should take you around 60-90 minutes to beat. I've set the difficulty to NORMAL for this sneak peek, but rest assured, the full release will offer a variety of difficulty options for your choosing.

If you haven't already, now is a perfect moment to [url=https://discord.gg/BEagkW6D38]join the Retrofiction Games Discord server[/url]. This is your opportunity to engage with fellow players, share your thoughts on the demo, and report any pesky bugs you may encounter. Alternatively, you can utilize the Community Hub on Steam and the dedicated threads for discussions.

I'm genuinely looking forward to hearing your feedback and hope you have an absolute blast with the demo!

Kind regards,
Markus
Retrofiction Games

notes.title: New trailer and new release window
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm thrilled to bring you some exciting news today.

Last year, I launched the store page with just a teaser trailer, and today, I'm delighted to share my first gameplay trailer with you!

This trailer is a sneak peek into the heart of the game. It dives into the core gameplay loop, showcasing combat, puzzles, and the intricacies of managing your inventory. Plus, it offers a glimpse into how crucial clues will be for solving some mind-bending puzzles. I've even included a selection of dialogue snippets to give you a taste of the storytelling that awaits. And, of course, the music you hear is straight from the finished game soundtrack!

You can watch it here or head to the store page to watch it.
[previewyoutube=Q21wPw3KtSo;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you enjoy it, let me know in the comments!


Now, I've got another update to share. While I initially aimed for a 2023 release, I've made the decision to shift the launch to sometime in 2024. Some parts of the game have become bigger and more complex than I anticipated, and I don't want to cut anything or take any shortcuts. It's done when it's done and I'm happy with the way things are progressing.

I appreciate your unwavering interest and support for the game. It means the world to me.

Stay tuned for more updates, and until next time, thank you for being part of this incredible community!

Warm regards,

Markus
Retrofiction Games
